transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some issues at work. With focusing. 

I manage a clinic, and... I'll sit down to do an EPIC quality report, or go into a metrics meeting, fully intending to track everything. But... after just a few minutes, my mind just drifts off. I end up rereading the same numbers over and over. Or I'll suddenly realize I completely missed the whole point of the discussion. So... that's what finally pushed me to come in.
Did you have similar attention problems when you were a child?

I guess... yeah. Um. Even back in elementary school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright, but careless. And... my mother usually had to sit right there with me so I'd actually finish my homework. I just... I'd lose track of the assignments, or I'd forget to bring my books home from school. So... yes.
Did you also have trouble sitting still or feel unusually restless as a child?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I had an issue with that. I was pretty quiet, usually.
Do you also have trouble with focus or attention in other parts of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. I mean, at home, I might start cleaning or doing something and then... just sort of wander off to do something else. And with friends, I suppose I can space out sometimes when they're talking. But... it's mostly just work that's the real problem.
Did you also have trouble sitting still or feel unusually restless as a child?
Um... I think you just asked me that. But... no. Like I said, I didn't really have an issue with that. I was a pretty quiet kid.
Have you ever had a lot of trouble with impulsivity, like acting before thinking or interrupting people?
No, not really. I don't... I don't think I do that. I mostly just keep to myself.
